checked.evidence: Vísir 9 Dec 2024: Supreme Court found insufficient grounds for the ISK 5m fine, decision partly annulled, refund with interest; procedural failures (right to respond) and part of the 16 Dec 2021 decision excessive. Vísir 16 Apr 2024: District Court in early Feb 2024 held Persónuvernd breached administrative law and ordered repayment; Supreme Court to hear directly. Persónuvernd 2024 annual report: decision 'staðfest að hluta' (partly upheld) in the Supreme Court. Exact leave date (article date is 16 April 2024) and the 'first court test' claim not confirmed.
checked.replacement: Persónuvernd fined Reykjavík City ISK 5 million on 3 May 2022 over use of the Seesaw platform in schools. Reykjavík District Court ordered a refund in February 2024 for breach of administrative procedure; the Supreme Court took the case directly (reported 16 April 2024) and on 9 December 2024 partly upheld the infringement findings but annulled the fine for insufficient grounds and procedural flaws, so the State had to refund it with interest.
